stages.name: Working status strip from the accepted seed (authoring branch)

criteria.check: Decode the delivered PNG as exactly 64x16: four horizontal 16x16 cells at x=0,16,32,48 with no gutters, padding or extra canvas; the consumer slices frame*16,0,16,16 for frames=4 and advances at display.frameMs 100 ms per frame (nominal 400 ms cycle).

In every cell, all pixels outside the activity marks have alpha 0; no opaque matte, plate, grey tile or fringe in any frame (the rejected generated frame whose background held 193 opaque #808080 pixels is this failure class). Partial alpha on mark pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.

When the provider result is not already the exact 64x16 four-cell sheet (more frames than four, another layout, gutters or padding), the retained assembly record names the exact source frames or cell rectangles in play order and every delivered cell is a lossless copy: no resize, resample, recolor, duplication or silent frame drop; all raw provider frames are retained beside the assembled strip.

Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 beside the exact Ready baseline, each frame and the running loop read as ongoing activity: no frame forms a check mark, an arrowhead, pause bars or a success-like terminal pose.

Play the actual four frames at 100 ms per frame including the fourth-to-first wrap: stable center and anchor, stable cluster count and volume in every phase, deliberate stepped phases with no morphing, near-hold or wrap jump (the rejected AI-animation failure class).

Readable compact silhouettes, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges, and a perceptible cool-blue accent related to the Ready baseline and the preserved Start accent, judged qualitatively at 1x and 3x on #172336; no exact hex, palette count, binary alpha, stroke width or margin rule.

Exercise started -> running through stateAfter and both statusCell and compactStatus with assets/working.png in the actual consumer renderer: label Working, frames 4, nearest sampling at scale 1 and 3, alpha compositing on #172336, and observed live 100 ms frame advance including the wrap.
Decode the delivered PNG as exactly one static 16x16 frame; no strip, animation or extra canvas.
All pixels outside the mark have alpha 0; no opaque matte, plate or fringe. Partial alpha on mark pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.

Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 in color and in grayscale, the mark reads as failed work / retry and is identifiable by shape alone against Ready, every Working frame, Paused and the preserved Start triangle; it must not be confusable with the Working activity loop.

Readable compact silhouette, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges, and a perceptible cool-blue accent related to the Ready baseline and the preserved Start accent, judged qualitatively at 1x and 3x on #172336; no exact hex, palette count, binary alpha, stroke width or margin rule.

Exercise error -> failed through stateAfter and both statusCell and compactStatus in the actual consumer renderer: label Retry, frames 1, path assets/error-retry.png (not the superseded assets/retry.png), nearest sampling at scale 1 and 3, alpha compositing on #172336, static behavior.
Decode the delivered PNG as exactly one static 16x16 frame; no strip, animation or extra canvas.

All pixels outside the mark have alpha 0; no opaque matte, plate or fringe (the rejected opaque magenta intermediate is this failure class). Partial alpha on mark pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.

Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 in color and in grayscale, the mark reads as paused work and is identifiable by shape alone against Ready (completion), every Working frame (activity), Retry and the preserved Start triangle.

Readable compact silhouette, deliberate coherent clusters and stepped edges, and a perceptible cool-blue accent related to the Ready baseline and the preserved Start accent, judged qualitatively at 1x and 3x on #172336; no exact hex, palette count, binary alpha, stroke width or margin rule.

Exercise pause -> paused through stateAfter and both statusCell and compactStatus in the actual consumer renderer: label Paused, frames 1, path assets/paused.png, nearest sampling at scale 1 and 3, alpha compositing on #172336, static behavior.

delivery.name: Queue status-family delivery: Ready, Working, Retry, Paused (authoring branch)

criteria.check: Compare all four actual members together at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 against the exact Ready baseline: coherent deliberate pixel treatment, readable visual weight, perceptible cool-blue accent and transparent exteriors, including Working's four frames and its actual 100 ms playback with the wrap; no exact palette, alpha, stroke, margin or copied completion-motif requirement.

View Ready, every Working frame and the running loop, Retry and Paused together at 1x and 3x including a grayscale/non-color comparison: Working never reads as success, and Retry and Paused are each distinct from activity, completion and from each other by shape or structure alone; the preserved Start triangle remains separately identifiable.

Exercise all backend transitions (started, ok, error, pause, plus idle) through both statusCell and compactStatus with the exact retained package files at the confirmed destination paths: labels, frame counts, horizontal slicing, 100 ms timing, nearest sampling at scale 1 and 3, alpha compositing on #172336 and recorded integer placement against the screenshot; assets/start.svg byte hash unchanged.
